name: scrapline
description: Scrapline — browser jetpack shooter with RL env (walking skeleton)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && tsc -b && npm run build --workspace=@scrapline/env && npm run build --workspace=@scrapline/server && node tools/stage-dist.js
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run build && vitest run --silent=false packages/core packages/client packages/env packages/server && node --test tests/skeleton.test.js tests/port-list.test.js tests/stage-dist.test.js tests/core-imports.test.js tests/perf-guardrail.test.js tests/prd-docs-refs.test.js tests/asset-pipeline.test.js tests/pwa.test.js tests/benchmark-refs.test.js tests/cohesion.test.js tests/theme-audit.test.js tests/tokens.test.js tests/milestone-closeout.test.js tests/licenses.test.js tests/sprite-captures.test.js tests/build-atlas.test.js tests/primitives.test.js
scripts.test:purity: node --test tests/core-imports.test.js && npx vitest run packages/core/tests/decorations.test.ts
